notes: Five identical op-amp stages, all drawn as downward-pointing triangles: the two inputs sit on the top edge and the output at the bottom vertex; in every one of the five the '+' glyph is left of the triangle centre, so index 0 (in+) = LEFT input, index 1 (in-) = RIGHT input, index 2 = out. Net map: 0 = all six GND symbols (18,19,20,21,22,23) plus the in+ of op-amps 16, 12, 11 and 2 and the left terminals of I-DC 13 and V-DC 1 — GND 20 sits on I-DC 13's left lead, GND 22 on V-DC 1's left lead, GND 19 -> op-amp 12 in+, GND 23 -> op-amp 2 in+, GND 21 -> op-amp 11 in+, GND 18 -> op-amp 16 in+. n1 = I-DC 13 right lead -> down at x~190 -> T at (190,69) -> op-amp 12 in- and (via the branch right to x~234) the top of inductor 8. n2 = op-amp 12 output -> down x~191 -> right at y~209 -> T with the bottom of inductor 8 at (245,209) -> the column continues down at x~247 through the crossing at (247,262) to the top of resistor 7, and the long y~262 horizontal joins it there, running left to x~102 and down to the top plate of capacitor 15, and right to x~310, down to y~307, right to x~372 and down into op-amp 4 in+. n3 = resistor 7 bottom -> op-amp 11 in- (x~252) with a branch right at y~342 and down to capacitor 9 top plate. n4 = op-amp 11 output -> down x~249, branch right at y~432 and up to capacitor 9 bottom plate, continues down to resistor 10 top. n5 = bottom rail at y~500..505: resistor 17 bottom, resistor 10 bottom, resistor 6 bottom (nothing else is on it). n6 = capacitor 15 bottom plate -> down x~108 -> op-amp 16 in-, with a T at (108,338) to the top lead of inductor 14. n7 = op-amp 16 output -> down x~105 -> T at (105,445) to the bottom of inductor 14 -> continues down into resistor 17 top. n8 = V-DC 1 right lead -> right to x~394 -> down; T at (394,74) sends a branch right to x~437 and down to the top plate of capacitor 0; the column continues down into op-amp 2 in-. n9 = op-amp 2 output -> down x~384 -> T at (384,211) to capacitor 0 bottom plate -> continues down into resistor 3 top. n10 = resistor 3 bottom -> down x~389 -> T at (390,318) branching right to x~438 and down to inductor 5 top -> continues into op-amp 4 in-. n11 = op-amp 4 output -> down x~387 -> T at (387,422) right to x~449 and up to inductor 5 bottom -> continues down into resistor 6 top. Judgment calls: (a) the only 4-way crossing in the drawing is at (247,262). At 30x there is a clear ink blob (~4x3 px, well above the ~1.5 px line weight) sitting on the intersection just below/right of it, and if it were a hop the whole y~262 horizontal (capacitor 15 top + op-amp 4 in+) would be an undriven floating net with no source at all. Both readings agree, so it is treated as a JUNCTION and n2 spans both runs. This is the one call a re-checker should look at first. (b) Op-amp 4 is the only stage whose in+ is not grounded — there is no seventh GND symbol anywhere near it, and the wire arriving at its left input is unambiguously the y~307 step off the long y~262 horizontal. (c) Op-amp 16 has capacitor 15 as its series input element (top plate to n2, bottom plate to the in- node) and inductor 14 as its feedback element; the T at (108,338) that ties inductor 14's top lead into the in- column was confirmed at 12x. (d) Capacitors 0, 9 and 15 are drawn with horizontal plates and vertical leads; their terminal index 0 is the top plate and index 1 the bottom plate. Resistors and inductors are all vertical, index 0 = top, index 1 = bottom. (e) I-DC 13 (arrow pointing right) and V-DC 1: index 0 = left lead (the grounded one), index 1 = right lead. 2-terminal order does not affect any metric. (f) No component is unconnected; every one of the 47 terminals lands on a traced net.
